name: incident.io MCP
description: Connects AI assistants to incident.io: query and manage incidents, analyze alert noise, check who's on call and handle escalations. For on-call and incident response teams.

skills.name: Incident Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes incident history grouped by severity, team, alert source and other dimensions, with responder workload breakdowns.

skills.name: Alert Noise Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes alerts by source, priority and time period to show which ones turn into real incidents and which are noise.

skills.name: On-Call & Escalations
skills.description: Checks who is on call, acknowledges pages, changes on-call cover and sets maintenance windows to hold back paging.

skills.name: Manage Incidents
skills.description: Creates and updates incidents, adds actions and follow-ups, merges duplicates and drafts status page updates for review.

skills.name: Investigations & Post-mortems
skills.description: Retrieves AI investigation findings and post-mortems for an incident, and starts or steers an investigation with new facts.
